name: Kernel-Agnostic MCMC
definition: An optimization process treating each primitive's opacity as a probability to identify 'dead' primitives and respawn them, addressing the limitation that heuristic strategies in 3DGS are tied to Gaussian properties.
summary: Kernel-Agnostic MCMC is an optimization strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses opacity regularization and Beta Kernel noise to replace heuristic densification, ensuring stability across different splatting kernels.
